descriptionFull: The blue grosbeak ( Passerina caerulea , formerly Guiraca caerulea ), is a medium-sized seed-eating bird in the same family as the northern cardinal, "tropical" or New World buntings, and "cardinal-grosbeaks" or New World grosbeaks.
